pie_root_standards.pie_roots_strict: Strict modern laryngeal Indo-European reconstruction (de Vaan 2008 Etymological Dictionary of Latin; Rix et al. 2001 LIV2; Kroonen 2013 Proto-Germanic; Beekes 2010 Greek). Separates converge (< Lat. vergere < PIE *h1werg-) from vortex (< Lat. vertere < PIE *wert-) and records [] where no established PIE root exists.
pie_root_standards.pie_roots_pokorny: Broad traditional Indo-European / classical root grouping (Pokorny 1959 IEW; Watkins AHD Appendix; Harper Etymonline), retaining Pokorny's *wer- ('to turn, bend', IEW 1152) root-extension grouping for converge and vortex.

classical_link_taxonomy.coined_translation_calque: Strict coined morphological translation calque (category: translation_calque): medieval Scholastic Latin actualitas coined specifically to render Aristotle's coined Greek energeia (actual <-> energy).
classical_link_taxonomy.classical_sense_overlap: Classical polysemy parallel (category: classical_polysemy_parallel): independent classical Latin verbs desiderare and exspectare sharing dictionary polysemy 'to long for, hope for' (desire <-> expect, WTWK proof 36 Ch. 2 p. 28, Ch. 5 p. 52); distinct from a coined translation calque.

historical_slot_swap_note: Notebook page 1 (2019-10-07) placed Momentum in the nonphysical M slot (m <-> M); in the 2020-07-06 published table, Movement replaced Momentum in the M slot while Momentum moved to the center continuum (Collection + Radiation -> Momentum; WTWK proof 36 pp. 41, 97). Under the strict Latinate -mentum/-ment stem filter, momentum <-> movement is excluded as orthographically related morphology.
